import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import pathlib,subprocess,sys,base64
p=pathlib.Path.cwd();z=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f','19','-l','19','-singlefile','-scale-to','1400','-png',str(p/'sources/monotone.pdf')],capture_output=True,timeout=30);assert z.returncode==0,z.stderr
w=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),'sources/monotone-page19.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(z.stdout).decode(),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=10);assert w.returncode==0
print('rendered primary page19 Figure1; no enumeration')
